A.title: Stair to Nowhere
A.text: The sky-stair broke off in the middle. What is left climbs a little way and then stops. Take the lower path through the cloud. It is the only one that goes on.

Y.title: The Hall of Winds
Y.text: The wind in this hall is trapped, and it knows. It pushes toward the doors. Stand with your back to the wall until a gust passes.

R.title: Breath of the Terrace
R.text: The old teachers stood here and breathed slowly until the air held them up. Not magic, they said. Only calm, practised.

G.title: Last Terrace Ledger
G.text: The terrace had a keeper, a gardener, and a gatekeeper. Three names, three pay lines. The pay stopped at the same date for all three.

M.title: The Veil, Thin Here
M.text: The mist hangs like cloth in the doorway. Pass through slowly. Rush it and it drags at you. It remembers every hurried step.

O.title: Sentry's Scratch
O.text: They guarded the stair from below. When the stair broke, the guard stayed. Nobody told them they could go. Guard note: relieve me, someone.

U.title: Palace Door Notice
U.text: Notice nailed to a door: the Accord was signed on this terrace, in the sun. After the signing there was a feast. After the feast, the forgetting.

X.title: Cloud Marker
X.text: A cairn of white stones at the lip of the terrace. One stone for every delver who went down to the last floor. I count nine. Add yours.
